about: Rothesay is a town in the Kennebecasis Valley of southern New Brunswick, a suburb upstream of Saint John on the Kennebecasis River. Tree-lined neighbourhoods, a heritage village feel, and a role as one of the KV’s established residential communities define the town beside Quispamsis. About 12,000 people live in Rothesay.
